quest.title: Strange Stone Chronicle
quest.description: Give Chesil's prototype clock to Puca. Perhaps a new production line will be born from this.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Primogem x20, Mora x10000

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you two, the ones who sold me those gemstones...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! You said something about turning them into pretty accessories the last time we met... How's that going?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon can't wait to see how they turned out!

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: About that... I'm afraid I must disappoint you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: I really wanted to inlay the gemstones in jewelry, but the ore is far too hard to polish by hand in any detail...

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: And that's not even the worst part. Who could have imagined that after being cut and polished, the ore would lose all its original glow?

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: Either way, they're not suitable for crafting at all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh... Paimon didn't expect things to turn out like this. We genuinely thought that these stones would be useful in some way...

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: Useful, you say... Well, it certainly isn't useless...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Chesil places a mechanical clock on the counter while speaking.

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: Look at this new mechanical clock — it was made using that very ore.

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: I was about to blame myself for misjudging the ore and was going to just get rid of it...

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: But then some clocksmiths came by and saw the scraps left over from our processing attempts. Since the ore was so durable, they took some with them and used it to make components for their clocks.

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: I was surprised to discover that thanks to the ore's high resistance to abrasion, it is superior to materials traditionally used for the moving components of clocks.

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: But if they're used to make clocks, the supply shipments would need to be even more reliable...

choices.text: I guess we can do that...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You tell Chesil about Puca and the ore veins.

response.speaker: Chesil
response.text: I see, then that is truly a happy coincidence! The prototype clock was created using the latest waterproof clam-style design — in other words, it was intended for Melusine use from the very start!

response.speaker: Chesil
response.text: In that case, could you bring this prototype to Miss Puca and explain the situation to her?

response.speaker: Chesil
response.text: After all, I've never done business with Melusines before... If Miss Puca could provide us with a stable supply, we'd be able to establish a whole new production line.

response.speaker: Chesil
response.text: I'll be sure to personally visit her in the future! Hmm... it would be a good idea to implement Melusine aesthetics into future clock designs...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, sounds like it'll benefit Puca too if you succeeded!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, this could be a great opportunity for Puca to start her own gemstone factory! C'mon, let's go talk to her!

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, it's been a while!

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Are you looking for the same strange rocks as last time?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, we are, but there's something else too...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You give Chesil's prototype clock to Puca and tell her about Chesil's plan to make clocks using the strange ore.

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: A—Amazing! They can make things like these out of those rocks!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? Only the bits inside are made from that stone...

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: You can even hear it ticking underwater... I've never seen a clock like this!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Chesil talked about it having an oyster-style structure... Or was it clam-style?

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Hehe, I'm happy just hearing the sound coming from the clock!

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: I never imagined that even ordinary stones like this would be so suited for something...

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: I always thought that you had to be like my sister, and only the rarest of gemstones could be turned into treasures. I never thought that you could also make something incredible with such ordinary rocks...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Everything has its value and purpose.

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm, I suddenly feel really good about myself!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Puca carefully places the clock in a nice place.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, now all you have to do is get the ore ready and sell it to Chesil when he needs it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then, you'll even be able to have your own gemstone workshop, just like your sister!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You've collected lots of different stones, after all. Maybe you'll be able to find a use for each and every one of them!

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Right! I'll definitely make preparations for that! Thank you so much!

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: If you ever need any rocks, come find me anytime!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, don't mention it!

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: If Miss Puca can provide a steady supply of ore, then perhaps we'll be able to mass produce these clocks.

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: Anyway, I'm counting on you!
